verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance/GRC platform, but the evidence describes Secureframe only as a hosted SaaS service reached through its app, API (api.secureframe.com) and hosted MCP endpoint. Nothing documents an on-prem or self-managed deployment of the core platform. Ingesting data from on-prem systems and the GitHub MCP server repo are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product, so they earn no credit.
